def _parse_foreign_key_violation(error_message: str) -> tuple:
    """Extract referencing property name and referenced id from a
    PostgreSQL ForeignKeyViolation error detail message.
    """
    error_property_name = re.search('Key \((.*?)\)', error_message).group(1).split(".")[0]
    error_ref_id = re.search('\)=\((.*?)\)', error_message).group(1)
    return error_property_name, error_ref_id
